headline: Export growth drives investment in the Cibao according to Francesca Rainieri
summary: Amcham DR president Francesca Rainieri said export growth and reconfigured international supply chains open opportunities to attract investment in Santiago and the northern region.
why: The American Chamber of Commerce in the Dominican Republic represents foreign investors, and its views signal business sentiment on investment in manufacturing hubs.
original_headline: Crecimiento de las exportaciones impulsa inversiones en el Cibao según Francesca Rainieri
